resources.string: Only messages sent as replies to another message trigger the auto-reply. The new reply, its referenced message when available, sender names, and selected previous messages are sent to your external AI provider. Generated replies are sent automatically on your behalf. Only enable for chats whose participants agree. Disabling stops new replies. One reply per minute, at most three per ten minutes; no reply catch-up.

Speed uses a short generated test, not the model-list request. Results are cached for 7 days. Up to 12 models are measured per test; run again to measure the next models. Failed models are skipped (×). Manual model ID works without a catalogue.

Open the menu of an individual chat to enable AI auto-reply. Available in ordinary personal chats, groups and forum topics; secret chats, bots, broadcast channels and mono-forums are excluded. Disabled by default. The API key is stored separately from exported settings.
Could not securely save settings. Check the device lock and try again.
Invalid value. Check the permitted range or URL.
This sends a short synthetic prompt to your provider and may incur API charges. Chat text is not sent.
Could not reach the AI provider. Check connection settings.
Changing the endpoint disables auto-reply in all chats. Enable each chat again to consent to the new provider.
